summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $98.1M from $68.2M.
The net loss widened to $87.0M, or −$2.38 per share, from $61.9M. Operating cash flow was −$79.9M and free cash flow −$81.9M, versus −$55.6M.
